# Publishing: YouTube

See [the YouTube guide](../../publishing/youtube.md) for how to get these values.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `publish.youtube.api-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_API_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-youtube-api-base-url` | string | `https://www.googleapis.com` | YouTube Data API v3 base URL |
| `publish.youtube.auth-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_AUTH_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-youtube-auth-base-url` | string | `https://oauth2.googleapis.com` | Google OAuth 2.0 token endpoint base URL |
| `publish.youtube.caption`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_CAPTION`<br>`--publish-youtube-caption` | string | — | YouTube video description |
| `publish.youtube.category-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_CATEGORY_ID`<br>`--publish-youtube-category-id` | string | `22` | YouTube category id; 22 is "People & Blogs" |
| `publish.youtube.client-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID`<br>`--publish-youtube-client-id` | string | — | Google Cloud OAuth client id **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.youtube.client-secret`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET`<br>`--publish-youtube-client-secret` | string | — | Google Cloud OAuth client secret **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.youtube.enabled`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_ENABLED`<br>`--publish-youtube-enabled` | bool | — | publish to YouTube (videos only) |
| `publish.youtube.fit`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_FIT`<br>`--publish-youtube-fit` | string | `none` | how the render is made to match youtube's frame: none, cover, contain or stretch; anything but none needs width and height |
| `publish.youtube.fit-background`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_FIT_BACKGROUND`<br>`--publish-youtube-fit-background` | string | `#ffffff` | hex colour behind a contain letterbox for youtube, and what transparency is flattened onto |
| `publish.youtube.height`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_HEIGHT`<br>`--publish-youtube-height` | int | — | render height for youtube; 0 inherits render.height |
| `publish.youtube.lead-video`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_LEAD_VIDEO`<br>`--publish-youtube-lead-video` | string, path | — | not available: a youtube post is pictures or a video and never both, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.youtube.max-attachments`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_MAX_ATTACHMENTS`<br>`--publish-youtube-max-attachments` | int | — | post at most this many pages to youtube at once; 0 uses the platform's own limit, which is also the ceiling |
| `publish.youtube.music-file`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_MUSIC_FILE`<br>`--publish-youtube-music-file` | string, path | — | not available: youtube has no API for attaching an audio file, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.youtube.overlay`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_OVERLAY`<br>`--publish-youtube-overlay` | list, path | — | template overlays applied for youtube only, after the global ones |
| `publish.youtube.privacy-status`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_PRIVACY_STATUS`<br>`--publish-youtube-privacy-status` | string | `private` | video privacy: private, unlisted or public; an API project Google has not audited gets private whatever is asked for |
| `publish.youtube.refresh-token`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN`<br>`--publish-youtube-refresh-token` | string | — | OAuth refresh token carrying the youtube.upload scope; it is traded for an access token each run **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.youtube.thumbnail`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_THUMBNAIL`<br>`--publish-youtube-thumbnail` | string, path | — | JPEG or PNG set as the video's thumbnail; it needs a phone-verified channel, so a refusal is a warning rather than a failed post |
| `publish.youtube.title`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_TITLE`<br>`--publish-youtube-title` | string | — | YouTube video title; empty uses the caption's first line, cut to 100 characters |
| `publish.youtube.width`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_YOUTUBE_WIDTH`<br>`--publish-youtube-width` | int | — | render width for youtube; 0 inherits render.width |

A sample carrying every key with its default is at
[`crier.example.yaml`](../../../crier.example.yaml).
